messages:
taylor_sre: Heads-up: We're scheduling a simulated evacuation of a 'hot' GPU shard in AZ-2 to validate our graceful-fallbacks and KV cache warmup. Window: 2026-04-02 02:00-02:20 UTC. Expected impact: short p99 latency spikes and a small increase in transient 502/503s during the drain, but no data loss. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/az2-hotshard-evac

sre-bot: Reminder created: 'AZ-2 hot-shard evacuation (simulated)' on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Calendar invite + runbook attached.

jamal_ops: Acked. What's the planned drain sequence? all nodes in shard at once or staggered?

taylor_sre: Staggered: drain two GPU pods at a time with 60s between batches. We'll enable immediate fallback routing to replica model-quant-v2 while nodes are rebalanced.

megan_oncall: I'm oncall that night — please add explicit alert suppression for noisy p99 page triggers. We'll only page if error rate > 1% sustained for 5m.

alex_runtime: Can we pre-warm KV prefixes for the most common request paths? I'll push a warmup job 30m before window: 
```bash
python tools/warmup_prefixes.py --shard az2 --prefixes /api/v1/generate,/chat --parallel 20
```

maria_prod: Heads-up: EU customers have a product demo starting 2026-04-02 02:10 UTC. Can we shift to 02:30 if possible?

taylor_sre: We can shift by 30m if no objections; current availability targets for the demo customer are high. Proposal: move to 02:30-02:50 UTC and update calendar. Thoughts?

jamal_ops: Shift works for ops. We'll still do a short warmup 02:00 as a dry-run if we move.

megan_oncall: Agree to move. Please post the adjusted SLO temp-policy so paging thresholds are clear.

alex_runtime: I'll schedule the warmup job at 02:00 and the drain at 02:30. Also will enable KV cache TTL extension to 2h during the test.

taylor_sre: Updated plan: Window now 02:30-02:50 UTC. SLO notes: temporarily relax p99 latency alert to 1.2s and error-rate page threshold to 1% sustained for 5m. Do NOT silence business-critical alerts (tagged critical_customer).

maria_prod: Thanks — appreciate the move. I'll notify the customer PM and ask them to stand down the demo.

jamal_ops: Small request: add a route-check after each batch to confirm traffic shifted correctly. Something like: 
```bash
curl -s https://infra-api/route-status?shard=az2 | jq .active_replicas
```
Will monitor during the run.

taylor_sre: Good call. We'll run that after every drain batch. Success criteria: 1) active replicas >= expected, 2) model-fallbacks routed without >0.5% errors, 3) no long-running coldstarts for 10m post-drain.

megan_oncall: Oncall checklist: pages enabled for critical_customer; alerts for p99 suppressed per plan; Ops channel will have live logs. I'll post the silence ID after creation.

sre-bot: Alert silence created: ID=AS-20260402-az2-evac, expires 2026-04-02T03:20:00Z.

taylor_sre: Post-test checklist: collect latency histograms, KV cache hit-rate, fallback-model quality quick-check (10 sample prompts), and drain logs. We'll reconvene at 03:00 UTC for a 15m retrospective.

alex_runtime: Noted. I'll upload warmup metrics to the test dashboard and tag the trace with evac-run-1719999999.

megan_oncall: I'll be in the Ops channel during the window. Ping me if the error-rate > 2% or if we see sustained p50 jumps.

taylor_sre: Thanks everyone. If anything changes before the window I will update this thread. :thumbsup:
